title: Classic V60 Pour Over
description: Clean cup with bright clarity; a reliable daily pour-over using a medium-fine grind and controlled spiral pours.

steps.instruction: Rinse the paper filter with hot water and discard the rinse.
Add 18g medium-fine coffee and create a flat bed.
Pour 40g water for the bloom and gently swirl the slurry.
Pour to 120g in slow circles avoiding the filter walls.
Pour to 250g total and keep the bed height even.
Let drawdown finish; target flat bed with no high-and-dry edges.

title: Double Shot Espresso
description: Balanced 1:2 ratio shot: sweet, full body, and a thin stripe of crema when dialed in.

steps.instruction: Grind 18g to a fine texture suitable for espresso.
Distribute evenly and tamp level with firm consistent pressure.
Lock in the portafilter and start the shot immediately.
Stop at 36g yield or when blonding begins; taste and adjust grind.

title: Overnight Cold Brew Concentrate
description: Smooth low-acid concentrate for diluting with water or milk; steep coarse grounds cold for many hours.

steps.instruction: Coarsely grind 120g coffee for a slow cold extraction.
Add grounds to a jar or cold brew maker with filtered water ready.
Pour 720g cold water and stir until all grounds are saturated.
Steep 12 hours in the fridge; strain through paper or metal filter.

title: French Press Full Immersion
description: Rich body and heavy mouthfeel; coarse grind and full four-minute steep before plunging slowly.

steps.instruction: Preheat the press with hot water then discard the water.
Add 30g coarse coffee to the empty press.
Pour 500g water at 200°F and stir the crust gently.
Plunge slowly in one steady motion; pour off any excess silt if needed.

title: AeroPress Standard
description: Versatile immersion-plus-pressure brew; quick cleanup and a clean cup with medium-fine grind.

steps.instruction: Place filter in cap, rinse, and assemble on a sturdy mug.
Add 15g medium-fine coffee then 250g water just off the boil.
Stir briefly at 10 seconds and attach the plunger slightly to seal.
Press gently for 20–30 seconds until you hear a hiss.

title: Chemex Iced Pourover
description: Bright iced coffee by brewing hot directly onto ice in the Chemex for immediate chill and clarity.

steps.instruction: Place 150g ice in the Chemex and set rinsed filter on top.
Add 22g medium grind coffee to the dry filter bed.
Bloom with 60g hot water and wait 30 seconds.
Pour remaining hot water to 330g total in slow pulses; swirl and serve over ice.

title: Moka Pot Stovetop
description: Concentrated stovetop coffee just shy of espresso; watch heat to avoid bitter over-extraction.

steps.instruction: Fill bottom chamber with hot water just below the valve line.
Fill basket with fine grind coffee level without compacting.
Screw together tightly and place on medium-low heat.
Remove from heat when coffee bubbles; run base under cool water to stop extraction.

title: Kalita Wave 185
description: Forgiving flat-bottom brew; even drainage and repeatable cups with three gentle pours.

steps.instruction: Rinse wave filters and preheat the brewer and server.
Add 20g medium grind and level the bed with a gentle tap.
Bloom with 50g water for 30 seconds without agitation.
Complete three pours to 320g total; keep water below filter rim.

title: Clever Drip Immersion
description: Full immersion steep with a clean drawdown; great for medium roasts and forgiving timing.

steps.instruction: Place filter in the Clever and rinse with hot water.
Add 22g medium grind coffee to the closed brewer.
Pour 360g water at 200°F and stir once gently.
At 3 minutes place on a carafe to drain; wait until drawdown completes.

title: Siphon Two-Chamber
description: Theatrical vacuum brewing with full clarity; control heat so the column does not boil violently.

steps.instruction: Heat filtered water in the lower globe until it rises to the upper.
Add 25g medium grind and submerge gently with a paddle.
Stir once at 30 seconds and maintain gentle heat.
Remove heat; coffee draws down through the filter into the lower globe.

title: Cowboy Coffee Camp Style
description: Rustic boil-and-settle brew when filters are scarce; coarse grind reduces sludge in the cup.

steps.instruction: Bring 500g water to a gentle boil in a small pot.
Remove from heat 30 seconds then add 32g coarse coffee.
Stir once and let steep four minutes without boiling.
Add a splash of cold water to settle grounds; pour slowly leaving sediment behind.

title: Turkish Coffee Fine Ibrik
description: Unfiltered ultra-fine grind with foam; stop before full rolling boil to keep bitterness low.

steps.instruction: Combine 7g extra-fine coffee with 70g cold water in the cezve.
Heat slowly while stirring until foam begins to form on top.
Pour a little foam into cups before returning the cezve to heat.
Repeat foam collection twice then let grounds settle before sipping.

title: Flash Brew Iced Filter
description: Japanese-style iced filter: part of the brew water is replaced with ice in the server for brightness.

steps.instruction: Place 100g ice in the server and set dripper with rinsed filter.
Use 18g coffee slightly finer than hot pour-over.
Bloom with 40g hot water then continue to 180g total hot.
Swirl the server to melt ice; dilute to taste if still too strong.

title: Nordic Light Roast Cupping Bowl
description: Evaluation-style steep for tasting lots; break the crust at four minutes and skim the surface.

steps.instruction: Weigh 12g coarse coffee into a bowl per sample.
Add 200g water just off boil and start a timer immediately.
Break the crust with two spoons and smell the wet aroma.
Skim foam and slurp when cool enough; spit if tasting many cups.
